title: AgentHaus Plugin Manifest
description: Schema for .claude-plugin/plugin.json in AgentHaus marketplace plugins. Aligned with the official Claude Code plugin manifest specification.

name.description: Plugin identifier in kebab-case. Used as the skill namespace prefix (e.g., /my-plugin:command).

description.description: Human-readable plugin description shown in the plugin manager

author.description: Plugin author — string or object with name and optional email

keywords.description: Keywords for plugin search and categorization

commands.description: Relative paths to command Markdown files or directories

agents.description: Relative paths to agent definition files

skills.description: Relative paths to skill Markdown files (skills/<name>/SKILL.md)

openapi.description: Relative path to an OpenAPI 3.1 specification for Gemini Extensions and OpenAI Actions compilation

capabilities_manifest.description: MCP capability declarations (tools, resources, prompts) for protocol-level discovery

tools.description: List of MCP tool names this plugin provides

resources.description: List of MCP resource URIs this plugin provides

prompts.description: List of MCP prompt names this plugin provides

description.description: Human-readable description of what this credential is used for

required_credentials.description: Credential declarations with scope and rotation metadata

oneOf.description: Inline hooks configuration. Mirrors the Claude Code hooks schema exactly — a key Claude Code does not define is dropped at load time with an 'unknown keys ... ignored' warning at startup, so a guard expressed through one silently does nothing. To require human approval, emit a permission decision from the hook command instead (see the 'command' description below).

matcher.description: Regex matched against the tool name, e.g. 'Bash' or 'Write|Edit'. Use '.*' to match every tool — a bare '*' is not a valid regex.

command.description: Shell command. The tool call arrives as JSON on STDIN — read it with jq (.tool_name, .tool_input.command, .tool_input.file_path). There is no $TOOL_INPUT/$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND environment variable. To gate the call, print {"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask"|"deny"|"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"..."}} on stdout, or exit 2 to block with stderr returned to the model. Any other non-zero exit is a non-blocking hook error.

if.description: Optional permission-rule filter, e.g. 'Bash(git commit *)'. The hook only runs when the tool call matches, which avoids spawning a process for every unrelated call.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for this command.

statusMessage.description: Status text shown in the spinner while the hook runs.

matcher.description: Regex matched against the tool name. Use '.*' to match every tool.

command.description: Shell command. The tool call and its result arrive as JSON on STDIN (.tool_name, .tool_input, .tool_response) — read them with jq, not from environment variables.

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for this command.

statusMessage.description: Status text shown in the spinner while the hook runs.

hooks.description: Relative paths to hook JSON files, inline hooks configuration, or hooks with HITL approval flags

command.description: Executable command to start the MCP server

env.description: Environment variables for the MCP server. Use ${ENV_VAR} for secrets.

mcpServers.description: MCP server configurations or path to .mcp.json

args.description: Arguments passed to the LSP server

extensionToLanguage.description: Map of file extensions to language identifiers

lspServers.description: LSP server configurations for code intelligence
